description: This file defines React components for the header view and related UI elements in a web-based test report application. It includes components for displaying the header, a global filter, navigation stats, and settings dialog. The code manages user interactions, URL-based filtering, and theme settings.

classes.name: HeaderView
classes.description: A React functional component that renders the main header bar with optional super headers and a title, which is linkified.

classes.name: GlobalFilterView
classes.description: A React functional component that displays search/filter controls and status navigation, allowing users to filter tests by query and status.

methods.name: StatsNavView
methods.description: A subcomponent rendering navigation links for different test stats categories, such as all, passed, failed, flaky, and skipped.

methods.name: NavLink
methods.description: A component rendering individual navigation links with counters, handling query parameter updates.

methods.name: SettingsButton
methods.description: A component rendering a settings icon that toggles a dialog for theme selection and merge files option.
